author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/54_Why is Biostatistics Important in Microbiology trending microbiology raqbamicroh（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 实验设计：取样、重复、对照
points.K2: 实验设计：避免偏倚，结果可靠
points.K3: 数据分析：数据又多又复杂
points.K4: 数据分析：概括、检验、找规律
points.K5: 做决策：差异是真的还是碰巧
points.S1: 数据完整：不挑、不改、不删
points.S2: 原始数据：备份留存，可追溯
points.S3: 样本量先算好，不做多余培养
points.S4: 计完数的平板，灭菌后再丢

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在微生物实验室里，身旁浮着柱状图和培养皿图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a microbiology teaching lab, a floating bar chart icon and a culture dish icon beside it, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天聊聊微生物实验里的统计。
overlay: 生物统计：让微生物数据说真话

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣指向三个图标：烧瓶、柱状图、天平
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to three floating icons: a flask, a bar chart and a balance scale.
shots.narration: 设计、分析、决策，三步都要它。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着两个培养皿对比，一个菌落多一个菌落少
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, in lab coat and gloves, compares two culture dishes: one with many colonies, one with fewer colonies.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现，加了药的平板菌落少些。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰兴奋地举手，头顶冒出感叹号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand excitedly, an exclamation mark icon above his head.
shots.narration: 他马上说：这个药有效！

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研拿着空白记录本走过来，摇摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over with a blank notebook and gently shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研问：做了几个平板？有对照吗？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，只伸出一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head and holds up one finger.
shots.narration: 阿杰愣住了：就各做了一个。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 一个平板，说明不了问题。

shots.section_title: 实验设计：取样、重复、对照
shots.scene: 一大片菌落中，取样勺从不同位置取样的图标
shots.prompt_en: A large culture tray with small scoop icons taking samples from several different spots across it. No people.
shots.narration: 先说实验设计。取样要有代表性，
overlay: 实验设计：取样、重复、对照

shots.section_title: 实验设计：取样、重复、对照
shots.scene: 同一处理的三个培养皿排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Three identical culture dishes lined up in a row for the same treatment, each with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 同一处理要做几个重复，

shots.section_title: 实验设计：取样、重复、对照
shots.scene: 处理组和对照组两排培养皿，中间一条竖线
shots.prompt_en: Two rows of culture dishes separated by a vertical line: a treated row with a small drop icon, and a control row without it. No people.
shots.narration: 还要设对照，才有比较的基准。

shots.section_title: 实验设计：取样、重复、对照
shots.scene: 小研在空白表格上画出分组方案
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sketches a group plan on a blank grid at her desk.
shots.narration: 这三样，动手之前就要想好。

shots.section_title: 实验设计：避免偏倚，结果可靠
shots.scene: 一只手只挑大菌落的平板，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand picking only the dishes with big colonies from a stack, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只挑好看的样本，就会有偏倚。
overlay: 实验设计：避免偏倚，结果可靠

shots.section_title: 实验设计：避免偏倚，结果可靠
shots.scene: 抽签箱里抽出编号球，分配到两组
shots.prompt_en: Numbered balls drawn from a lottery box are assigned to two groups of culture dishes. No people.
shots.narration: 随机分组，能减少人为偏向。

shots.section_title: 实验设计：避免偏倚，结果可靠
shots.scene: 培养皿上贴着空白编号贴，看不出组别
shots.prompt_en: Culture dishes carry blank number stickers, so the groups cannot be told apart. No people.
shots.narration: 计数时不看组别，结果更客观。

shots.section_title: 实验设计：避免偏倚，结果可靠
shots.scene: 天平两边平稳，旁边一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale sits level with a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 设计好了，研究才可靠。

shots.section_title: 数据分析：数据又多又复杂
shots.scene: 一条S形曲线从坐标轴升起
shots.prompt_en: An S-shaped growth curve rises on a blank chart axis. No people.
shots.narration: 微生物实验，数据又多又杂：
overlay: 数据分析：数据又多又复杂

shots.section_title: 数据分析：数据又多又复杂
shots.scene: 一长串彩色条带像基因序列一样滚动
shots.prompt_en: A long ribbon of colored blocks scrolls across the frame like a gene sequence, with no letters. No people.
shots.narration: 测出来的基因序列，

shots.section_title: 数据分析：数据又多又复杂
shots.scene: 一叠培养皿和计数器图标，菌落被一个个点亮
shots.prompt_en: A stack of culture dishes and a hand tally counter icon, colonies lighting up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 还有成百上千个菌落计数。

shots.section_title: 数据分析：数据又多又复杂
shots.scene: 小研面前电脑屏幕上满是空白表格
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student faces a computer screen filled with large blank spreadsheets.
shots.narration: 光靠眼睛看，根本看不过来。

shots.section_title: 数据分析：概括、检验、找规律
shots.scene: 一大堆散点收缩成一个均值点和误差线
shots.prompt_en: A cloud of scattered dots shrinks into one mean point with an error bar. No people.
shots.narration: 统计能把一大堆数据概括出来，
overlay: 数据分析：概括、检验、找规律

shots.section_title: 数据分析：概括、检验、找规律
shots.scene: 问号气泡旁出现对勾和叉号两个选项
shots.prompt_en: A question mark bubble with a check mark and a cross offered as two choices. No people.
shots.narration: 用检验回答假设对不对，

shots.section_title: 数据分析：概括、检验、找规律
shots.scene: 散点图中浮现一条趋势线
shots.prompt_en: A trend line emerges through a scatter plot of dots. No people.
shots.narration: 还能从数据里找出规律。

shots.section_title: 做决策：差异是真的还是碰巧
shots.scene: 两组柱状图，高低略有不同
shots.prompt_en: Two bar charts side by side with slightly different heights. No people.
shots.narration: 两组结果不一样，是真有差别吗？
overlay: 做决策：差异是真的还是碰巧

shots.section_title: 做决策：差异是真的还是碰巧
shots.scene: 一枚硬币抛起，旁边是骰子
shots.prompt_en: A coin flips in the air next to a rolling die. No people.
shots.narration: 也可能只是碰巧。

shots.section_title: 做决策：差异是真的还是碰巧
shots.scene: 两个菌株图标和两种处理图标之间一个天平
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale between two bacteria strain icons, then between two treatment drop icons. No people.
shots.narration: 比处理、比菌株，都要靠统计判断。

shots.section_title: 做决策：差异是真的还是碰巧
shots.scene: 老周看着带误差线的柱状图点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man looks at a bar chart with error bars on a monitor and nods.
shots.narration: 差异显著，结论才站得住。

shots.section_title: 做决策：差异是真的还是碰巧
shots.scene: 阿杰把平板补成每组三个，排得整整齐齐
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, in lab coat and gloves, lines up three dishes for each group neatly at the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰重新设计，每组都做了重复。

shots.section_title: 数据完整：不挑、不改、不删
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张数据表，表上每个格子都有对勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank data table with a small check mark in every cell.
shots.narration: 统计算得再好，数据得是真的。
overlay: 数据完整：不挑、不改、不删

shots.section_title: 数据完整：不挑、不改、不删
shots.scene: 橡皮擦改数字、剪刀剪掉数据行的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eraser rubbing out a cell and scissors cutting a row from a table, crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不挑数据，不改数字，不删记录。

shots.section_title: 数据完整：不挑、不改、不删
shots.scene: 一个偏离的点被圈出，旁边一张写好的说明卡
shots.prompt_en: One outlying dot on a chart is circled, with a small blank note card attached beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 去掉异常值，要按事先定的规则，

shots.section_title: 数据完整：不挑、不改、不删
shots.scene: 小研在记录本上写下说明并签名
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes a short note in her notebook and signs it.
shots.narration: 并且写明理由，留下记录。

shots.section_title: 数据完整：不挑、不改、不删
shots.scene: 老周和小研一起看原始数据和统计结果
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student compare a raw data sheet with a chart on the monitor together.
shots.narration: 结果对不上预期，也如实报告。

shots.section_title: 原始数据：备份留存，可追溯
shots.scene: 电脑里的数据文件复制到移动硬盘和服务器图标
shots.prompt_en: A data file icon on a computer copies to an external drive icon and a server icon. No people.
shots.narration: 原始数据要及时备份，
overlay: 原始数据：备份留存，可追溯

shots.section_title: 原始数据：备份留存，可追溯
shots.scene: 原始文件上挂着锁，旁边复制出一份分析副本
shots.prompt_en: An original data file with a small lock icon, and a copy of it being made for analysis. No people.
shots.narration: 原始文件不动，在副本上分析。

shots.section_title: 原始数据：备份留存，可追溯
shots.scene: 从结果图到原始数据，一串箭头倒推回去
shots.prompt_en: A chain of arrows leads back from a final chart to a spreadsheet and then to a notebook page. No people.
shots.narration: 每个结果，都能追到原始数据。

shots.section_title: 原始数据：备份留存，可追溯
shots.scene: 文件柜和日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A filing cabinet icon beside a calendar icon with a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 按学校规定的期限保存。

shots.section_title: 样本量先算好，不做多余培养
shots.scene: 一堆堆满的培养皿被打叉，旁边是一小排整齐的培养皿
shots.prompt_en: A huge pile of culture dishes crossed out with a red X, next to a small neat row of dishes with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 重复不是越多越好。
overlay: 样本量先算好，不做多余培养

shots.section_title: 样本量先算好，不做多余培养
shots.scene: 小研在电脑前计算，屏幕上一个计算器图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calculates at a computer, a calculator icon on the screen.
shots.narration: 动手前，先估算需要多少样本。

shots.section_title: 样本量先算好，不做多余培养
shots.scene: 每多一个平板，就多一只手、一个废物袋图标
shots.prompt_en: Each extra culture dish adds a gloved hand icon and a biohazard waste bag icon with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 多一轮培养，就多一次接触和废物。

shots.section_title: 样本量先算好，不做多余培养
shots.scene: 阿杰在生物安全柜前规范操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student works carefully at a biosafety cabinet in lab coat, gloves and goggles.
shots.narration: 够用就好，每一次都规范操作。

shots.section_title: 计完数的平板，灭菌后再丢
shots.scene: 计数完的平板堆在桌上，旁边普通垃圾桶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Counted culture dishes stacked on a bench, an ordinary trash bin beside them crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 计完数的平板，里面还是活菌。
overlay: 计完数的平板，灭菌后再丢

shots.section_title: 计完数的平板，灭菌后再丢
shots.scene: 阿杰把平板放进贴生物危害标志的废物袋
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places used culture dishes into an autoclave bag with a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 放进专用的感染性废物袋，

shots.section_title: 计完数的平板，灭菌后再丢
shots.scene: 老李把废物袋放进高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer loads the biohazard bag into an autoclave and closes the door.
shots.narration: 先高压灭菌，再按规定处置。

shots.section_title: 计完数的平板，灭菌后再丢
shots.scene: 小研摘手套、洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes her gloves and washes her hands at the lab sink.
shots.narration: 收工后，摘手套、洗手再记录。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在三个图标前：烧瓶、柱状图、天平
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of three icons: a flask, a bar chart and a balance scale.
shots.narration: 一起回顾一下。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 取样、重复、对照三个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three icons light up one by one: a sampling scoop, three identical dishes, and two rows of dishes split by a line. No people.
shots.narration: 设计：取样、重复、对照，防偏倚。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 散点收成趋势线，旁边硬币被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Scattered dots gather into a trend line, and a flipping coin beside it is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 统计帮我们分清真差异和碰巧。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 数据表、锁和备份硬盘图标
shots.prompt_en: A data table icon, a lock icon and a backup drive icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 数据真实完整，备份可追溯。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 小排培养皿和高压灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: A small neat row of culture dishes beside an autoclave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 样本够用就好，平板灭菌再丢。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研一起挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 数据求真，实验求稳，下次见！
